sourceBucket.description: The bucket of the object to copy.

sourceKey.description: The key of the object to copy.

sourceVersionId.description: A version of the source. Default: the current one.

key.description: The key to copy to; an object there is replaced.

contentType.description: A new content type. With it or metadata the copy gets them instead of the source's.

metadata.description: New user metadata instead of the source's: lower-case names, printable ASCII values.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
